description.en: The Rail Rack 8 is a robust and scalable mining rack designed to accommodate up to 8 high-performance mining units. This rack is engineered for stability and optimal airflow, ensuring that even under heavy load, the units maintain their cool. Its sleek, rail-inspired design allows for easy access and simple scalability, making it a favorite among those looking to expand their mining operations efficiently.
